remarks: ALL UTILITIES INCLUDED IN RENT! This beautiful four bedrooms, two full bathrooms house is located in a peaceful, family friendly neighborhood- perfect for those looking for comfort and tranquility. Features include: spacious living room/ dining room area with natural light, modern kitchen with two sinks - one of them has specialty filters installed for drinking water, high class appliances, including washer and dryer. Three nice sized bedrooms, master with separate bath on the main level. Lower level has additional room that can serve as a bedroom or office. There is also a sunroom for extra space that overlooks beautiful, professionally landscaped backyard with in ground pool. The house is located minutes from schools, parks with easy access to major roads for commuting.
